content.text: Register doesn't pass a provider, so the default applies.

candidates.explanation: The provider defaults to AuthProvidersEnum.google when createUserDto.provider is missing. AuthService.register calls usersService.create without a provider, so every email-registered user is stored with provider 'google'. Login then fails the `user.provider !== AuthProvidersEnum.email` check in AuthService.validateLogin and returns 422 `needLoginViaProvider:google`.
register() creates the user without setting provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email, so it relies on the wrong default in UsersService.create.

fix.description: Change the default to AuthProvidersEnum.email. Optionally also pass provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly in AuthService.register.
